title: Beyond the universal Dyson singularity for 1-D chains with hopping disorder
relevance: Pure hopping disorder preserves sublattice symmetry and has a known band-center anomaly. This supplies a physical discriminator for the untested frequency-disorder expectation, not a new mechanism.
